Distribution revenue for our international networks segment is largely dependent on the number of subscribers that receive our networks or content, the rates negotiated in the distributor agreements, and the market demand for the content that we provide. The other significant source of revenue for international networks relates to advertising sold on our television networks and across other distribution platforms, similar to u.s. Networks.
